_about: Descriptions for Blueprint-visible members that have no doc comment in the plugin source. Each was written from the implementation (file noted). Key: Owner.MemberName.
UAPSViewLibrary.SetVisualizerMode: Set what the APS Visualizer shows: 0 nothing, 1 everything, 2 status only (each AI's state over its head). Sets the console variable aps.Visualizer, so it applies to every Visualizer. (APSViewLibrary.cpp)
UAPSViewLibrary.SetVisualizerPage: Choose the page the Visualizer's screen panel shows: 0 Senses, 1 Memory, 2 Brain, 3 Squad, 4 Events, 5 Player Model, 6 Environment. Sets the console variable aps.VisualizerPage. (APSViewLibrary.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetSquadID: This AI's squad name, as set by Set Squad ID. None when it is in no squad. (PerceptionCore.h)
UPerceptionCore.SetProfile: Give this AI a different Perception Profile while playing. Called from inside an APS event, the swap waits until that perception pass ends. When the new profile has the same senses, the AI keeps everything it believes and only the values change; a profile with different senses rebuilds them and the AI starts fresh. Does nothing when passed None or the profile it already has. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.Profile: The Perception Profile this AI uses: everything it perceives and how sharply. Set it in the Details panel; while playing, use Set Profile. (PerceptionCore.h)
UPerceptionCore.GetTopTargetBelief: Everything this AI believes about its top target (the one it ranks first). Returns false when it believes in no one. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetBeliefData: Everything this AI believes about one target: its confidence, state, last known position, prediction, threat, loss reason and more. Returns false when it holds no belief about that actor. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetAwarenessLevel: How alert this AI is overall, judged from its top target's confidence: Unaware, Peripheral, Suspicious, Alerted or Fully Aware. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetAwarenessLevelForTarg: How aware this AI is of one target, from that target's confidence. Unaware when it holds no belief about it. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetActiveTargetCount: How many actors this AI currently holds a belief about in the Suspected, Detected, Tracked or Lost state. Places, and things marked with APS Evidence, are not counted. When this falls to 0, On AI All Clear fires. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.HasAnyDetection: True while this AI's awareness is above Unaware. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetSenseContributions: Each sense's own confidence about a target, by sense name (Vision, Hearing, ...): did it see you, or only hear you? Returns false when the AI holds no belief about the target. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetLastKnownPosition: Where this AI last placed the target. (0, 0, 0) when it holds no belief about it. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetPredictedPosition: Where this AI expects the target to be by now, from how it was moving. Only moves past the last known position while the target is unsensed and the profile's Enable Prediction is on. (SpatialBeliefModel.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetUncertaintyRadius: How unsure the AI is of where the target is, as a radius in cm around the last known position: it grows while the target is unsensed, up to the profile's Max Uncertainty Radius, and shrinks when it is sensed again. A ready-made search radius. (SpatialBeliefModel.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetEstimatedVelocity: The target's velocity as this AI has measured it, smoothed. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetEstimatedAcceleration: How the target's velocity has been changing, as this AI measured it: a sudden sprint or stop. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetLastSeenCoverActor: The actor that blocked the AI's view when it lost the target from Detected or Tracked: the crate or wall you slipped behind. None when nothing was found. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.WasTargetInCover: True when the target was behind cover at the moment it was lost. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetPlayerBehaviorModel: What this AI has learned about how a target behaves: its habits, favourite routes and hiding places. Returns false when the profile's player model is off or nothing has been learned yet. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.ResetPlayerBehaviorModel: Forget everything this AI has learned about a target's behaviour. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetEmotionalState: This AI's five emotions, each 0 to 1 (fear, aggression, curiosity, alertness, panic), and the dominant one. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetDominantEmotion: The emotion that leads right now. Panic wins over all others once it passes the profile's Panic Override Threshold. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetThreatLevel: How much of a threat this AI thinks one target is: None, Low, Medium, High or Critical. None when it holds no belief about it. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetHighestThreatLevel: The highest threat level among everything this AI believes in. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetRelationship: What this AI takes the target for (enemy, friend, neutral, ...), as its APS Relationship resolved it. Unknown when it holds no belief about it. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetStimulusSource: Which sense first made this AI notice the target. Unknown when it holds no belief about it. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.GetCombatRole: The combat role this AI holds in its squad, or None. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.HasThreatAtOrAbove: True when anything this AI believes in is at this threat level or higher. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.SetSquadID: Put this AI in a squad, by name; AI with the same squad name share what they perceive. None takes it out of any squad. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.ShareTargetWithSquad: Tell this AI's squadmates everything it believes about a target, now. Does nothing when the AI is in no squad, holds no belief about the target, or the belief is about a thing (APS Evidence) rather than a person. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.RequestCombatRole: Claim a combat role in this AI's squad. Each role is held by one squad member at a time: returns false when another member holds it, when the AI is in no squad, or when the role is not in the profile's Eligible Roles (if that list has any). Claiming a role gives up the role it held before, and fires On Combat Role Assigned. (PerceptionCore.cpp, SquadSystem.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.ReleaseCombatRole: Give back this AI's combat role, so a squadmate can take it. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
UPerceptionCore.IsRecording: True while Start Recording is capturing this AI's belief. (PerceptionCore.h)
UPerceptionCore.SmoothedConfidence: Not updated by APS 3.0: always 0. Read Smoothed Confidence from Get Top Target Belief or Get Belief Data instead. (PerceptionCore.h)
UPerceptionCore.CurrentState: Not updated by APS 3.0: always UNAWARE. Read the state from Get Belief Data, or Get Awareness Level, instead. (PerceptionCore.h)
UAPSSubsystem.GetAgentCount: How many AI with APS Core are running in this world. (PerceptionSubsystem.h)
UAPSSubsystem.SetAmbientLight: Set the world's light level for APS, 0 (dark) to 1 (full daylight): drive it from your day and night cycle. (PerceptionSubsystem.h)
UAPSSubsystem.SetWeatherModifier: Set how much the weather leaves of the AI's senses, 0 to 1: 1 is clear, and lower values mean heavier rain (it sets the rain intensity to 1 minus this). (PerceptionSubsystem.h)
UAPSSubsystem.GetEnvironmentState: The world's current conditions as APS uses them: light, rain, wind, indoors and time of day. (PerceptionSubsystem.h)
UAPSSubsystem.SetWindState: Set the world's wind: the direction it blows and its speed. Smell uses it outdoors. (PerceptionSubsystem.h)
UAPSSubsystem.SetIndoors: Tell APS the world is indoors (or not): indoors concentrates scent and ignores the wind. (PerceptionSubsystem.h)
UAPSSubsystem.SetTimeOfDay: Set the time of day, in hours (0 to 24). For your own logic and the Visualizer: APS's senses don't read it. (PerceptionSubsystem.h)
USenseUnit_Pain.GetHealthRatio: The health fraction the Pain sense is using, 0 to 1, read each tick from the APSHealth Provider interface or a health function on the pawn, else as set by Set Health Ratio. (SenseUnit_Pain.h)
USenseUnit_Pain.GetPainState: The health band from that fraction: Healthy above 0.75, Wounded above 0.40, Critical above 0.15, Near Death below. (SenseUnit_Pain.h)
UAPSSearchComponent.IsSearching: True while a search is running (between Begin Search and End Search). (APSSearchComponent.h)
UAPSEnvironmentComponent.bOverrideLight: Inside this volume, use Light Level instead of the world's light. (APSEnvironmentComponent.h)
UAPSEnvironmentComponent.bOverrideRain: Inside this volume, use Rain Intensity instead of the world's rain. (APSEnvironmentComponent.h)
UAPSEnvironmentComponent.RainIntensity: Rain inside this volume, 0 (dry) to 1 (downpour). Rain shortens vision, hearing and smell. (APSEnvironmentComponent.h)
UAPSEnvironmentComponent.bOverrideWind: Inside this volume, use this Wind Direction and Wind Speed instead of the world's wind. (APSEnvironmentComponent.h)
UAPSEnvironmentComponent.WindDirection: The way the wind blows inside this volume. Smell uses it. (APSEnvironmentComponent.h)
UAPSEnvironmentComponent.WindSpeed: How hard the wind blows inside this volume. (APSEnvironmentComponent.h)
UAPSEnvironmentComponent.bOverrideIndoor: Inside this volume, use Is Indoors instead of the world's setting. (APSEnvironmentComponent.h)
UAPSEnvironmentComponent.SmellRangeScale: How far smell reaches inside this volume: 1 changes nothing, 0.5 is half as far, 2 is twice as far. (APSEnvironmentComponent.h)
UPainTypeDefinition.SenseEffects: Which senses this pain dulls, and how much: each entry is a sense and an effect from 0 to 1. At full pain, an effect of 1 takes that sense down to its floor. (PainTypeDefinition.h)
UPerceptionProfile.MinVisiblePoints_Crou: How many of a crouched target's sample points must be visible before it registers at all. 1 by default (stance changes nothing); raise it to 2 for stance-aware stealth. (PerceptionProfile.h)
UPerceptionProfile.MinVisiblePoints_Pron: How many of a prone target's sample points must be visible before it registers at all. 1 by default; raise it to 3 for stance-aware stealth. (PerceptionProfile.h)
UPerceptionProfile.ThreatWeight_Confiden: How much the AI's confidence in a target counts toward its threat score. The five weights are added up and the score is kept between 0 and 1. (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.ThreatWeight_DamageRe: How much the damage the target has done to this AI counts toward its threat score (100 damage counts in full). (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.ThreatWeight_Senses: How much it counts toward the threat score that several senses perceive the target at once: the number of active senses is divided by 8 (the most sense slots an AI can have), so a two-sense AI can add at most a quarter of this weight. (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.ThreatWeight_Relation: How much who the target is counts toward its threat score: Feared 1.5, High Value 1.2, Enemy 1, Unknown 0.5, Neutral 0.3, Friendly and Teammate 0. (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.ThreatWeight_Approach: A flat bonus to the threat score while the target is Detected or Tracked (sensed right now), nothing otherwise. The approach factor is 1 whenever the AI senses the target in APS 3.0, so this does not measure closing speed. (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.ThreatThreshold_Low: The threat score (0 to 1) at which a target becomes a Low threat. (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.ThreatThreshold_Mediu: The threat score at which a target becomes a Medium threat. (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.ThreatThreshold_High: The threat score at which a target becomes a High threat. (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.ThreatThreshold_Criti: The threat score at which a target becomes a Critical threat. (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.MaxAggression: The highest aggression can climb to, 0 to 1. 0 turns aggression off. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.MaxCuriosity: The highest curiosity can climb to, 0 to 1. 0 turns curiosity off. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.MaxAlertness: The highest alertness can climb to, 0 to 1. 0 turns alertness off. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.MaxPanic: The highest panic can climb to, 0 to 1. 0 turns panic off. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.FearRiseRate: How fast fear rises, per second, while the AI is hurt, faces more than two targets, faces a critical threat, or a pain type feeds it fear (a pain's fear input also multiplies this rate). (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.FearDecayRate: How fast fear falls, per second, once nothing is in front of the AI and no high threat remains. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.AggressionRiseRate: How fast aggression rises, per second, while the AI is hurt, tracks a target, or faces a high threat. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.AggressionDecayRate: How fast aggression falls, per second, once no target is left and nothing has hurt it. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.CuriosityRiseRate: How fast curiosity rises, per second, while the AI only suspects something, or has heard something it can't see. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.CuriosityDecayRate: How fast curiosity falls, per second, once a target is Tracked or Lost, or nothing is left. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.AlertnessRiseRate: How fast alertness rises, per second, while a target is Detected or Tracked. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.AlertnessDecayRate: How fast alertness falls, per second, at all other times. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.PanicRiseRate: How fast panic rises, per second, while fear is above 0.8 with more than one target, or a pain's fear input is above 0.9. (EmotionalState.cpp)
UPerceptionProfile.PanicDecayRate: How fast panic falls, per second, once fear is below 0.5 and the pain's fear input below 0.3. (EmotionalState.cpp)
USoundTypeDefinition.SoundName: The sound's name. On AI Hear passes it as the sound type's name, so you can branch on it, and it becomes part of the sound's stimulus tag (Stimulus.Sound.<name>). (PerceptionSoundSystem.cpp)
USoundTypeDefinition.Category: What made the sound: Enemy, Friendly, Animal, Environment or Custom. A Sound Filter Profile can accept only some categories. (PerceptionSoundSystem.cpp)
USoundTypeDefinition.AlertLevel: How alarming the sound is: Whisper, Normal, Loud or Explosive. A Sound Filter Profile can ignore sounds below a level. (PerceptionSoundSystem.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.Target: The actor this belief is about. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FBeliefRecord.TargetID: A number that identifies the target. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FBeliefRecord.FusedConfidence: The senses' combined confidence this update, before smoothing. (MemoryEngine.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.SmoothedConfidence: The confidence the AI acts on, 0 to 1, after smoothing: the states, the events and the meter all use this one. Use it for detection meters. (MemoryEngine.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.LifecycleState: Where the belief is in its life: Undetected, Suspected, Detected, Tracked, Lost, Remembered or Expired. (MemoryEngine.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.TimeSinceLastSensed: Seconds since any sense last had the target. (MemoryEngine.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.TotalTimeTracked: How long, in all, the target has been Tracked. (MemoryEngine.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.LastKnownPosition: Where the AI last placed the target. (SpatialBeliefModel.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.EstimatedVelocity: The target's velocity as the AI measured it, smoothed. (SpatialBeliefModel.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.EstimatedAcceleration: How the target's velocity has been changing. (SpatialBeliefModel.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.UncertaintyRadius: How unsure the AI is of where the target is, in cm around the last known position: grows while it is unsensed. (SpatialBeliefModel.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.PredictedPosition: Where the AI expects the target to be by now. (SpatialBeliefModel.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.LongTermMemoryStrength: A slow memory of the target, 0 to 1: it builds while the target is sensed and fades slowly once it is gone. (MemoryEngine.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.DetectionCount: How many times the target has been noticed: each rise out of Undetected, and each time it is found again after being Lost or Remembered. (MemoryEngine.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.bWasEverDetected: True once the target has ever been noticed. (MemoryEngine.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.FirstDetectedTime: The world time, in seconds, when the target was first noticed. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.bWasInCover: True when the target was behind cover at the moment it was lost. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.ThreatLevel: How much of a threat the AI thinks the target is: None, Low, Medium, High or Critical. (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.ThreatScore: The threat score behind Threat Level, 0 to 1. (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.DamageReceivedFromTarget: How much damage the target has done to this AI. Fades over time while the target is lost (the profile's Threat Damage Decay Rate). (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.DamageDealtToTarget: Not filled in by APS 3.0: it stays 0. (PerceptionTypes.h, PerceptionCore.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.bIsKnownThreat: True once the target has been Tracked. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.EncounterCount: How many separate encounters the AI has had with the target: one for each rise from Undetected to Suspected. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.LastThreatLevel: The threat level before the most recent change: compare it with Threat Level to see which way the threat moved. (ThreatAssessor.cpp)
FBeliefRecord.Relationship: What the AI takes the target for (enemy, friend, neutral, ...), as its APS Relationship resolved it. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
FAPSLocationObservation.Confidence: How sure the sense is of it, 0 to 1. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FAPSReplicatedTargetState.Target: The actor this state is about. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FAPSReplicatedTargetState.Confidence: The AI's confidence in the target, 0 to 1. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FAPSReplicatedTargetState.State: The belief's state: Undetected through Expired. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FAPSReplicatedTargetState.ThreatLevel: How much of a threat the AI thinks the target is. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FAPSReplicatedTargetState.LastKnownPosit: Where the AI last placed the target. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FPerceptionSenseResult.Confidence: This sense's confidence about the target, 0 to 1. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FPerceptionSenseResult.RawSignalStrength: The signal before falloff and the other multipliers: for your own debugging. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FPerceptionSenseResult.EstimatedLocation: Where this sense places the target. Imprecise senses (hearing, smell) place it roughly. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FPerceptionSenseResult.LocationAccuracy: How precise that position is, 0 to 1. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FPerceptionSenseResult.bIsActive: True while this sense is perceiving the target. When false, the rest is ignored. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FAPSPerceptionFrame.State: The belief's state at that moment. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FAPSPerceptionFrame.Awareness: The AI's overall awareness at that moment. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FEnvironmentState.LightLevel: The light level, 0 (dark) to 1 (full daylight). Vision sees less in the dark, unless a per-target light value overrides it. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FEnvironmentState.RainIntensity: Rain, 0 (dry) to 1 (downpour). Rain shortens vision, hearing and smell. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FEnvironmentState.WindSpeed: How hard the wind blows. Smell carries less the stronger it is, outdoors only. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FEnvironmentState.WindDirection: The way the wind blows. Smell reaches further downwind. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FEnvironmentState.bIsIndoors: True indoors: scent is stronger and the wind is ignored. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FEnvironmentState.TimeOfDay: The time of day in hours, 0 to 24. Informational: APS's senses don't read it. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FPerceptionContext.HearingRangeScale: How far hearing reaches here, from any APS Environment volume the AI stands in: 1 changes nothing. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FPerceptionContext.SmellRangeScale: How far smell reaches here, from any APS Environment volume the AI stands in: 1 changes nothing. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FAPSMemorySubject.Actor: The actor the memory is about, when it is about an actor. (APSMemory.h)
FAPSMemorySubject.Location: Where the remembered place is, when it is about a place. (APSMemory.h)
FAPSViewPoint.Location: Where the sample point is on the target. (APSViewTypes.h)
FAPSViewPoint.State: Whether vision gets through to the point: Seen (more than half gets through), Partly (glass, foliage or smoke lets some through, too little to count) or Blocked. (APSViewTypes.h)
FAPSSenseRanges.Vision: How far vision reaches right now, in cm. (APSViewTypes.h)
FAPSSenseRanges.Smell: How far smell reaches right now, in cm. 0 when the AI has no smell. (APSViewTypes.h)
FAPSSenseRanges.Vibration: How far vibration reaches right now, in cm. 0 when the AI has no vibration sense. (APSViewTypes.h)
FAPSSenseRanges.Echolocation: How far echolocation reaches right now, in cm. 0 when the AI has no echolocation. (APSViewTypes.h)
FPerceptionContext.DeltaTime: The length of this update, in seconds (the AI's perception tick). (PerceptionCore.cpp)
FPerceptionContext.AmbientLightLevel: The light level where the AI is, 0 (dark) to 1 (full light): from the environment, 1 when there is none. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
FPerceptionContext.WeatherVisibilityMod: How much of its sight the rain leaves the AI: 1 minus the rain intensity, 1 when dry. (PerceptionCore.cpp)
FPerceptionContext.TargetVelocity: How fast, and which way, the target moves. (PerceptionTypes.h)
FAPSEvidence.Operation: What the evidence does to confidence: Raise (a floor it can't fall below), Clamp (a ceiling), Lower (settles it below what the senses say), or Invalidate. (PerceptionCore.h)
FPendingContactEvent.ContactType: What kind of contact it was. (SenseUnit_Touch.h)
FAPSKnowledgeEntry.EntryId: This entry's id within its faction: pass it to Get Entry or Forget Entry. (APSKnowledgeSubsystem.h)
FAPSKnowledgeEntry.LastKnownLocation: Where the subject was last reported. (APSKnowledgeSubsystem.cpp)
FAPSKnowledgeEntry.Confidence: How strongly the faction believes the entry, 0 to 1: it fades while nobody reports it again, and the entry is dropped below the subsystem's Entry Forget Threshold. (APSKnowledgeSubsystem.cpp)
FAPSSearchPoint.Location: Where to look: a reachable point on the navmesh. (APSSearchComponent.cpp)
FAPSDescriptor.Traits: The traits that make up the description: each a key (such as Coat), a value (such as Red) and how easy it is to notice. (APSTraits.h)
UAPSKnowledgeSubsystem.Get: The Knowledge module's world subsystem, from any Blueprint. None if there is no world. (APSKnowledgeSubsystem.cpp)
UAPSKnowledgeSubsystem.GetEntry: Look up one entry of a faction's knowledge by its id (the id Report Observation returned). Returns false when the faction has no such entry: it was forgotten, faded or merged. (APSKnowledgeSubsystem.cpp)
UAPSKnowledgeSubsystem.GetEntryCount: How many entries a faction currently holds. (APSKnowledgeSubsystem.h)
UAPSKnowledgeSubsystem.ForgetFaction: Drop everything a faction knows and reset its alert level, at once. (APSKnowledgeSubsystem.cpp)
UAPSKnowledgeSubsystem.RaiseFactionAlert: Add to a faction's alert level (kept between 0 and 1) and fire On Faction Alert Changed. Amounts of 0 or less are ignored. (APSKnowledgeSubsystem.cpp)
UAPSKnowledgeSubsystem.SetFactionAlert: Set a faction's alert level outright (kept between 0 and 1) and fire On Faction Alert Changed. (APSKnowledgeSubsystem.cpp)
UAPSKnowledgeSubsystem.OnKnowledgeUpdate: Fires when a report reaches a faction: a new entry, or one merged into an existing entry. Gives the faction and the entry's id. (APSKnowledgeSubsystem.cpp)
UAPSKnowledgeSubsystem.OnFactionAlertCha: Fires when a faction's alert level changes: raised, set, or noticeably decayed over time. Gives the faction and its new alert, 0 to 1. (APSKnowledgeSubsystem.cpp)
UAPSSignatureComponent.GetSignature: The full set of traits this actor carries (its Signature), as set in the Details panel or by Set Trait and Remove Trait. (APSSignatureComponent.h)
FAPSMemorySubject.bIsPlace: True when the memory is about a place (named by Place Tag) rather than an actor. (APSMemory.h)
FAPSViewFan.Kind: Which cone this is: focal, peripheral or rear. (APSViewTypes.h)
FAPSViewFan.ToDeg: The angle, in degrees about world up from the cone's forward direction, where the cone's outline ends. The outline runs from From Deg to To Deg. (APSViewTypes.h)
FAPSHeardSound.SoundType: The Sound Type Definition of the sound that was heard. (APSViewTypes.h)
FAPSHeardSound.bClearPath: True when nothing stood between the sound and the AI's ears; false when walls muffled it (see Walls). (APSViewTypes.h)
FAPSSenseRanges.PeripheralHalfAngle: Half the width of the peripheral cone, in degrees. (APSViewTypes.h)
FAPSSenseRanges.RearMotionHalfAngle: Half the width of the rear motion cone, in degrees, measured from directly behind the AI. (APSViewTypes.h)
